title: Hoover Dam
summary: Hoover Dam is a concrete dam in Black Canyon on the Colorado River between Arizona and Nevada, about 30 miles southeast of Las Vegas. Contractors had seven years from 20 April 1931; the first concrete went in on 6 June 1933 and all features were complete on 1 March 1936. It is 726.4 feet high.

uncertainty.note: Start is the contract date of 20 April 1931 (Bureau of Reclamation); end is 1 March 1936, when all features were completed. ASCE gives completion as 1935 and dedication on 30 September 1935 by Franklin D. Roosevelt.
